D1 歴 - 紀: history; passage of time
D2 期 - 紀: period (geological/time period)
D3 代 - 紀, 賃: era/geological era (紀); price, charge or fee (賃)
D4 規 - 紀: rules; discipline (紀律, 綱紀, 風紀)
D5 律 - 紀: law; discipline
D6 則 - 紀: rule; regulation
D7 典 - 紀: rules; reference texts or records
D8 法 - 紀: law; rules
D9 捜 - 索: search; look for
D10 探 - 索: search; seek
D11 査 - 索: investigate; inquire
D12 求 - 索: seek; request (もとめる)
D13 調 - 索: investigate; inquire
D14 究 - 索: investigate thoroughly; inquire
D15 散 - 索: scattered; dispersed (索然)
D16 糸 - 索, 維: thread; cord; strand
D17 結 - 維: tie; bind
D18 括 - 維: tie together
D19 隅 - 維: corner (四維)
D20 基 - 維: foundation; fundamental principle (大綱)
D21 給 - 賃: pay; wages
D22 俸 - 賃: salary; wages
D23 価 - 賃: price; payment for goods or services
D24 値 - 賃: price; charge
D25 費 - 賃: expense; charge
D26 払 - 賃: pay; payment
D27 貨 - 賃: freight; money
D28 雇 - 賃: hire
D29 貸 - 賃: rent out; lease
D30 賞 - 賃: reward; remuneration
D31 償 - 賃: recompense; compensation
D32 税 - 賃: levy; charge
D33 金 - 賃: money; payment
E1 史 - 紀 exclusion target; needed to judge the history/chronicle overlap and the declared 紀/史 pair
E2 記 - 紀 exclusion target; needed to judge the record/account overlap and the declared 紀/記 pair
E3 誌 - 紀 exclusion target; needed to judge the written record/journal overlap and the declared 紀/誌 pair
E4 録 - 紀 exclusion target; needed to judge the record/register overlap and the declared 紀/録 pair
E5 緒 - 索 exclusion target; needed to judge the cord/rope overlap with 索 and the undeclared 緒/維 pair
E6 借 - 賃 exclusion target; needed to judge the rent/hire overlap and the declared 賃/借 pair
E7 料 - 賃 exclusion target; needed to judge the fee/charge overlap and the declared 賃/料 pair
